statement: Pinned BlueZ HID-over-GATT requires an attached GATT HID service and obtains VID/PID/version from device metadata. Once Report Map and enumerated reports are available, BlueZ creates a UHID_CREATE2 HID device with BUS_BLUETOOTH and the acquired Report Map; it need not construct a physical USB interface. HOGP enforces security/bonding on the real radio path. BlueZ hog.c lines 62-85,188-206; shared hog.c lines 842-897; uhid.c lines 391-445.

applicability.revision: host sources Linux v7.3, SDL e0232c5 and 531acc, BlueZ aa4f5ce; device firmware not measured
applicability.scope: Consumer source evidence, not physical Bluetooth or virtual-host observation. Virtual UHID bypasses real HOGP pairing and cannot assert Bluetooth RF functionality.
